title: Teaching Diffusion to Speculate Left-to-Right
abstract: arXiv:2606.11552v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve remarkable performance across a wide range of tasks, but their autoregressive decoding process incurs substantial inference costs due to inherently sequential token generation. Speculative decoding addresses this bottleneck by employing a lightweight draft model to propose multiple future tokens that are subsequently verified in parallel by a larger target model. Recent work has demonstrated that diffusion language models are well suited for this setting, as they can generate entire blocks of draft tokens in parallel and thereby alleviate the sequential constraints of autoregressive drafting. translated_title: 教会扩散模型从左到右进行推测（Teaching Diffusion to Speculate Left-to-Right）
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在广泛的任务中取得了卓越的性能，但其自回归解码过程由于固有的顺序性token生成而带来了高昂的推理成本。推测解码通过采用轻量级草稿模型提出多个未来token，再由更大的目标模型并行验证，从而缓解了这一瓶颈。近期研究表明，扩散语言模型非常适合这一场景，因为它们能够并行生成整块的草稿token，从而突破了自回归草稿生成的顺序性限制。然而这一机制存在一个微妙之处：块扩散草稿模型在块内以双向方式生成token，而验证则由严格从左到右评估token的自回归目标模型完成，这导致对称的训练时目标与非对称的（验证方式之间存在差距）……
tldr: 该论文提出让扩散草稿模型以从左到右的方式生成推测token，从而弥合块扩散草稿的双向生成与自回归目标模型严格左到右验证之间的不对称差距，提升推测解码的效率。
en_tdlr: This paper teaches block-diffusion drafters to speculate in a left-to-right manner, bridging the asymmetry between bidirectional diffusion drafting and strictly left-to-right autoregressive verification to improve speculative decoding.
